capstone_pipeline.scenario: Fernhill support agent: answer the 8 fixture tasks from the 18 document knowledge base inside the course's standard 4,000 token window.
capstone_pipeline.fixed_before_build: 2026-11-06, in Lesson 29, before any pipeline code was written (Lesson 30).

definitions.recall: Mean stand-in use rate of the task's required facts in the assembled context, 20 seeded trials (ctx/standin.py).
definitions.coverage: Fraction of required facts present anywhere in the assembled context, regardless of position.
definitions.precision: Tokens of the task's relevant documents divided by total assembled tokens.
